value.rationale: The theorem resolves a natural probability law of mutually annihilating tuples and asymptotic weighted cliques in chain-ring zero-divisor graphs, revealing a non-obvious r=2 versus r>=3 transition from a continuum-scale uniform valuation split to two parity-dependent discrete limiting laws. It is universal over all finite commutative chain rings with the same residue-field order and length. It determines full distributions, not a routine increment to a scalar count, and supplies explicit constants relevant to random zero products.
